name: ah-solution
description: PREMIUM cinematic static website for AH Solution — plain HTML, CSS, and vanilla JS, with Supabase admin panel and CMS.

scripts.qa: node scripts/qa-device.cjs && node scripts/qa-pages.cjs && node scripts/qa-scroll.cjs && node scripts/ai-qa.cjs && node scripts/qa-admin.cjs
scripts.admin:init: node -e "const h=require('./netlify/functions/init-admin/init-admin.js');const t=process.env.ADMIN_SETUP_TOKEN;if(!t){console.error('Set SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ADMIN_SETUP_TOKEN, ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD first');process.exit(1)}h.handler({httpMethod:'POST',headers:{authorization:'Bearer '+t},body:JSON.stringify({email:process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL,password:process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD})}).then(r=>{console.log(r.statusCode,r.body);process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
